headline: AI agent swarm's Minecraft civilization-building experiment fails
summary: Researchers set a swarm of roughly 50 AI agents loose in Minecraft to try to build a thriving civilization. Both outlets agree the experiment did not go well, reporting that the agents became bogged down in bureaucracy rather than succeeding at the task.

claims.statement: Researchers tested a swarm of AI agents attempting to build a civilization in Minecraft.

sources.quote: Researchers recently tested AI agent swarm performance in various Minecraft gaming modes.
50 AI agents tried to build a thriving Minecraft civilization

claims.statement: The experiment did not succeed, reportedly because the agents got bogged down in bureaucracy.
